success.title: Order complete!
success.text: Thanks for your order – your purchase is now complete. You will receive an email confirmation shortly.

failed.title: Unable to process payment.
failed.text: We were unable to process your payment for this order – this could be for a number of reasons. Please click below to go to your invoice where you can retry your payment.

invalid.title: Your session has expired
invalid.text: We're unable to retrieve your past order as your session has expired. To start a new purchase, please click the button below to return to our store.
